sentence: This project uses artificial intelligence and fractal geometries to design fasteners for robotic assembly, inspired by gecko feet, burrs, and bird feathers.
This project studies how autonomous mobility systems can adapt their movements to the safety preferences of each individual using eyeglasses.
This project builds algorithms that analyze large graphs and networks while protecting data privacy.
This project builds three software platforms that make cloud computing for artificial intelligence, quantum computing, and research collaboration easier to use.
This project tests whether weather forecasts can stay skillful longer than two weeks by using machine learning models that learn from data.
This project builds a framework to explain how the structure of river networks affects the way water, sediment, and nutrients move across the landscape.
This project studies the corona, the hot outermost layer of the solar atmosphere, using data from total solar eclipses and computer simulations.
This project studies how changes in a cancer-related repair gene affect protein function and genetic stability using yeast-based assays.
This project builds a computer method that predicts protein function and explains its predictions using generative deep learning and a knowledge graph.
This project builds understandable machine learning tools that use galaxy survey data to address conflicting measurements of how clumpy the Universe is.
This project programs bacteria to make antitumor nanobodies in tumors and to break open and release them when given the artificial sweetener erythritol.
This project grows high-quality single crystals in hot, high pressure water to study their magnetic and optical properties.
This project studies underutilized and resilient crop species, such as lentils and prickly pear, in work on global food security.
This project develops methods to help computers recover the 3D shape and material of an object, including shapes with holes through them.
This project builds a multiscale model of how an electric field effect between adjacent cells affects the heart when gap junctions are impaired.
This project tries to find out which molecules make up the signaling complexes that let plants sense light and temperature and adjust growth.
This project builds artificial intelligence infrastructure and research on automated medical imaging, malware in cloud software, and efficient use of cloud computing resources.
